title: Q-STD-SLSA: attach SLSA v1 build provenance to every Worker deploy
body:
**Owner:** platform-engineer
**Trigger:** standards register entry slsa-provenance is planned (STANDARDS-1)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation standards --probe slsa-provenance
**Prediction:** standards_supported_share >= 0.8 within 336 h
**Status:** closed

`deploy/deploy-workers.mjs` records each deploy in `ops/deploys.jsonl`. Emit an in-toto statement with a SLSA v1 provenance predicate for each uploaded Worker bundle (subject: bundle sha256; buildDefinition: repository, commit, workflow; runDetails: run id), store it beside the deploy row, and attest it with GitHub artifact attestations where the deploy runs in Actions. Add a test that checks the statement shape, then mark the register entry `supported`.

**Out of scope:** signing with a key a person must mint, or changing how or when Workers deploy.

**Closing probe:** cmd:python3 -m foundation standards --probe slsa-provenance

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-26T03:44:52Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 6.1 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
